original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 introduces increased validation checks in gRPC communication to the control plane that are incompatible with cert-manager's istio-csr versions prior to v0.12.1, causing authentication handshake failures.

decision.reason: [ev-f0029965e392] says Istio adds stricter validation checks to its internal gRPC communication with the control plane. It also says clients without the fix fail with "missing selected ALPN property". That makes this a wire-protocol change to Istio's own gRPC handling, with the same configuration and different semantics. So protocol-behavior with behavior-changed fits, and the name grpc-control-plane-alpn-validation uses the evidence's own key words. The ALPN part of the name comes from the error message, not from a direct statement of what is checked, so confidence is low.
